title: Mode Dock Tab Drag Preview
description: Remove inconsistent tab drag feedback (dashed insert slots, thick insert line, body highlight) when dragging Mode dock tabs; keep only a clean cursor-following tab preview.
summary: Tab-bar drop preview: when dropZone is tab, insert a ghost tab (border-2 border-accent bg-accent/20) at the target index via modeDockTabsWithInsertPreview so remaining tabs shift to match the post-drop order. Multi-tab chrome grid recomputes columns including the ghost. Cursor tab chip hides over tab-bar drops; split drops still use the floating chip and half-panel overlay.
